steps.content: [Chief's Office]

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Bianca's identity has been confirmed. She is indeed a journalist from DisTV News. Additionally, we found out that she submitted a research topic about this platform a week after the Gray Mirror download link began spreading.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Any anomalies regarding her M-value?

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: No, she's just an Eastside citizen with a very clean background. No signs of M-value fluctuations.

The Public Security Bureau has sent a double confirmation of Bianca's identity. The journalist's presence alone keeps you on edge, not only due to her suspicious behavior, but also because she's irritatingly eager to jump into dangerous situations. You really fear that one day she might get herself killed.
The news Roxanne brought has temporarily dispelled some of your suspicions. Just as you hang up the call, a head pops up from under your desk...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Has it started yet? When will we get our big scoop?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I told you to wait for me in the studio. Why must you follow me everywhere...

She's completely unbothered by your cautious attitude toward her, not to mention these minor jabs. She keeps rolling over your office desk excitedly. Despite the NDA she had to sign, being the assistant to the Public Security Bureau's special investigator and being allowed in a secret agency's base are enough to thrill her.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I was so excited last night, I couldn't sleep!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Never thought I would get the chance to work with the Public Security Bureau! Me! This Bianca!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We don't know who the next victim will be. Stay rational and alert. The first step in our plan is to prevent Mania from harming more people.
You grab Bianca, who is rolling around on the desk. If you didn't need her help for your next move, you'd be tempted to throw this high-frequency nuisance out immediately.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've already sent out people to monitor the potential Purge targets. Soon we'll be able to remotely watch them prevent the Purge from happening.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Wow, I thought you were just bluffing. Or can you really see the future?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm monitoring those with high Inferior votes and updating the watchlist constantly. It takes collective efforts to curb Mania, not the power to foretell the future.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ahh...That's was not as cool... <color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color> is disappointed.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: One step at a time. Monitoring and prevention are the first steps of all operations. Once we're on track, it will be your chance to shine.

If the information from Bianca and Simon is correct, an account gets purged by Gray Mirror when its Inferior votes reach 90%, and at the same time, the user is also attacked by the force of Mania in reality.

The creator of this method that transforms malice into Mania is still unknown. There must be other secret connections between Gray Mirror and the dark web besides the identical technological framework. But for now, you can at least intervene by monitoring every victim listed on Gray Mirror in real time.
[Cafe]
On the surveillance screen, Wynn knocks on an apartment door. The woman inside seems to be on a call, and she nervously removes one earphone as the guards file in.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Is she our surveillance target?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, one of them. Shawn is a popular podcaster who maintains intimate relationships with multiple followers online. She got exposed and put up for a vote. As more and more netizens claim to be her true partner, her Inferior votes have only been surging.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I am in charge of monitoring the vote for "Hopeless Romantic, quote, No Flings, end quote" on Gray Mirror. Your cooperation will be greatly appreciated.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: ...How can I trouble such a delicate flower like you over a mere vote on Gray Mirror? Let me protect you instead. Here, you can always lean on my shoulder.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Sir, I will notify you immediately if the votes reach the execution threshold. Please be ready for combat at all times.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Okay. I'll try not to punch her in the face before that.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Oh, the cold, thorny rose has pricked me...
[Newsroom]

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: I've told you many times, I can't be late for this important interview! Let me through!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Sorry, you can't leave. Due to the aggressive language in your past coverage, your votes on Gray Mirror are dangerously high. You must remain under the surveillance of our guards for now.

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: And Gray Mirror says I'm your mother! Move away!
Just as Morghan tries to force her way through, Ethan holds her back.

steps.speaker: Ethan
steps.content: Hey, I'm stuck here too. Apparently, the tone of my coverage is too ambiguous. There are too many bizarre posts on Gray Mirror now. They're only trying to keep us safe. Just bear with it.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Oh wow, those two look exactly like my colleagues. They even talk the same way. Could they be their twins?

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: I never should have listened to Bianca and downloaded that damn voting app!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: And she actually knows me? Talk about a coincidence!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Have you considered that they could indeed be your colleagues?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Oh come on, grow a sense of humor! (*´ω｀)
[Public Security Bureau]
On Gray Mirror, Roxanne is currently being voted on for treating her subordinates harshly and obstructing the trials.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: We still haven't found the user who put you up for voting, Ma'am. We even tried using the method Bianca used to extract information from Simon, but to no avail.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: Never mind, finding Simon was a stroke of luck anyway. Gray Mirror and the dark web are notorious for their anonymity, and Chief has said the technology is rather complicated. Anyway, don't worry about me, we sheriffs have seen it all, and being targeted myself is not all bad: we can at least gather more leads for Chief.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: They're even voting against the sheriffs now?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The votes on Gray Mirror have turned indiscriminate now. They target anyone who stands out.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: But many in the bureau believed that voting post. They seem to have many gripes about you.

steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: I know, it said I did nothing about the disappearance cases and even protected the prime suspect. You can't make everyone think the same or shut them all up. Let them talk.
[Chief's Office]

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: So, now we just wait for the next execution and protect the victim in time, right?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Does that mean I can see those little tentacles coming out of the phone again?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You're not gonna believe it, but I kind of miss that Gray Mirror monster.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You know, Eastside always boasts about being Mania-free. Most Eastsiders don't even know what a Mania monster looks like! If I could capture it with my camera, it would definitely make headlines!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: It's a shame all information about Mania has to be kept secret this time... Is that really possible though? What if rumors are already all over the place where we can't see them? If I were a Sinner, I wouldn't have to follow the confidentiality rules, right?

options: You want to become a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Yeah, then I'd have superpowers. Maybe I could teleport between different crime scenes and catch all the bad guys, and the front-page news would be all mine!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As an Eastsider, aren't you afraid of the Sinners and Mania?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Why? You don't seem afraid of them either. Be honest... you're not some secret investigator from Eastside, right? Aren't you afraid of Eastside then?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What's there to be afraid of in Eastside?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Gray Mirror, duh! Every Eastsider hiding behind the internet has turned Gray Mirror into what it is now!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hasn't Gray Mirror always been like this?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hmm, that was a long, long time ago. Back then, there was no such thing as purging users on Gray Mirror, and nothing would happen to people with high Inferior votes. Users just gathered around to vote and seek validation. That's why no one initially linked the disappearances to Gray Mirror.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Although it's satisfying to vent your anger and feel validated through voting, in reality, no real justice was ever served. As long as the judgments remained virtual, Gray Mirror couldn't break out of its niche in the corner of DisCity's dark web.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Has the Gray Mirror app been around for a long time?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hmm, it was initially only known to a small community on the dark web. I think it only got popular... about three months ago?

options: Three months is not a very long time, is it?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Huh? Three months is a whole season! It's rare to see a trending topic last a week here. In Eastside, three months is for sure a long time. It's enough to air an entire anime series from start to finish.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: If you don't believe me, go out and ask someone if they remember what was trending three months ago! No one would be able to answer you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That... makes sense.
Maybe you're just not sensitive enough to time in Eastside. After all, you can't even get a good night's sleep in three months.
And you must admit that as long as this promising young journalist can stay away from danger, teaming up with her has been a good idea. Her enthusiasm, knowledge, and opinions are equally valuable.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even the fact that it's from DisCity's dark web hasn't deterred its explosive popularity... I see, just like power, it's a dangerous and delicious temptation that most cannot resist. Its popularity is an inevitable outcome.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The low cost of simply tapping on your phone, the absolute power of purging others, and the moral validation of justice by majority vote. Whether these three are indeed connected or not, and no matter how they are related, Gray Mirror offers an illusion of possessing them all at once.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Initially, everyone just treated it as an emotional trash can, a cyber court, or some kind of debate competition. It was no different from the other social apps they would quickly tire of. Its popularity only exploded when...

options: When it was rumored to devour people.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Yes, that was exactly when!
Beep—

Gray Mirror voting data update: The number of active users continues to increase, and the votes of monitored individuals are nearing the execution threshold. On the surveillance screen, targets from all over the city exclaim in fear one after another.
Behind the trending social app, dark tentacles slither out of the screen as digitalized Mania shatters the boundary between virtuality and reality. The Purge crisis continues to spread.
